app.name: Novocore
app.unreachable.title: Novocore is not answering
app.unreachable.body: The server could not be reached. This is not a sign-out — your session may still be valid once it is back.
auth.failed: That username and password combination was not accepted.
language.label: Language
nav.notBuiltHint: Visible to you because you have full access. There is nothing behind it yet.
page.notBuilt.title: Not built yet
page.notBuilt.body: This screen is planned but has not been built.
page.notFound.title: No such page
page.notFound.body: The address does not match anything in this application.
page.noAccess.title: Not available to you
page.noAccess.body: Your role does not include this section. Ask an administrator if you need it.
page.placeholder.body: The foundations for this screen are in place. It is built on {{endpoint}}.
registry.adaptersBody: External systems Novocore talks to. None is built yet, and these switches store nothing — there is no API behind them.
registry.modulesBody: Internally-driven features. None is built yet, and these switches store nothing — there is no API behind them.
field.unreachable: The server could not be reached, so nothing was saved.
products.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this product? It stays in the ledger and in past documents; it stops being offered for new ones.
products.serialTrackedHint: Each unit is tracked by serial number
products.column.name: Name
suppliers.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this supplier? It stays on every document it is already on.
suppliers.column.name: Name
vatStatus.label: VAT status
vatStatus.reasonRequired: This VAT status needs an exemption reason before it can be saved.
vatStatus.vatNumberRequired: This VAT status needs a VAT number. Set the VAT number above first — it is saved separately.
vatStatus.vatNumberRequiredToCreate: This VAT status needs a VAT number.
customers.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this customer? They stay on every document they are already on.
customers.column.name: Name
customers.system.badgeTitle: Novocore's own logic locates this record. Parts of it are fixed.
customers.system.cannotDeactivate: This is the shared retail record, not a real customer. Every till sale with no identified buyer is recorded against it, so deactivating it would leave those sales with nobody to be against.
customers.system.vatFixed: Fixed at Domestic. This record is not one identifiable party, so it cannot make a claim about a party's VAT status.
customers.system.noVatNumber: A shared anonymous record cannot hold one party's VAT number.
roles.restrictionsBody: Fields removed from every response this role receives, wherever they appear. A hidden field is absent rather than blank.
roles.holdersBody: Including deactivated accounts: they hold the role too, and a role cannot be deactivated while anybody is in it.
roles.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this role? It is refused while anybody still holds it — move them to another role first.
roles.notBuiltTitle: This section can be granted, and there is nothing behind it yet. The grant is stored, so the permission is already in place when the feature arrives.
roles.fullAccessBody: This role has full access to everything, including sections added later. It carries no individual grants, which is why every row below reads Full.
roles.descriptionFixed: Set when the role is created. There is no route to change it.
roles.descriptionOnlyNow: This is the only chance to set it — there is no route to change a description afterwards.
roles.createGrantsLater: A new role grants nothing at all. Choosing its sections is the next step, on the role's own page — creating a role and granting it access are separate acts, each audited on its own.
roles.column.name: Name
roles.flag.systemTitle: Owner and Admin. Nobody may edit them — without that, removing Users & Roles from the last role that has it would lock everyone out.
roles.locked.systemRole: '{{name}}' is a system role and cannot be changed. Without this, removing Users & Roles from the last role that has it would lock everyone out of user administration.
roles.locked.ownRole: This is your own role, and you cannot change what it may see. Changing the permissions of the role you hold would let one person grant themselves access nobody else approved — ask another administrator.
roles.locked.cannotConfer: You hold {{held}} here, so you cannot grant {{level}}. Access can only be passed on, never invented.
roles.locked.fullAccess: This role's access is the full-access flag rather than a grant, so there is nothing here to change.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this account? It stops working immediately, including any session it has open. It is not deleted — the audit log still refers to it.
users.usernameFixed: Fixed. The audit log and every record's author refer to it, so it has to stay explicable.
users.languageIsTheirs: Chosen by the account holder, in their own session. Shown here, not set here.
users.locked.ownAccount: You cannot change your own role. Moving yourself into a role you can edit would let one person grant themselves any access in the system — ask another administrator.
users.password.title: Set a password
users.password.body: A password has been generated for {{username}}. It is not set until you confirm.
users.password.activeBody: This is now {{username}}'s password. Take it before closing — it cannot be shown again.
users.password.label: Password
users.password.shownOnce: Shown once. Nothing stores it and no route returns it, so a lost password can only be replaced, never recovered.
users.password.endsSessions: Setting a password ends every session that account has open.
users.password.acknowledge: I have copied this password and can give it to {{username}}.
users.password.generatedOnCreate: A password is generated when the account is created, and shown once, immediately afterwards.
